input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use covenant binds Sparkling anywhere in the Agreement. Section 3 (Restrictions on Use) is limited to ordinary software-licence use restrictions (no copying beyond backup/internal use, no assignment or sublicence, no reverse engineering, use only as authorised) and does not restrict the businesses Sparkling may operate or the products it may buy or build. Searches for "compet", "similar software", "develop", "exclusiv" and "shall not" return only a non-exclusive licence grant, confidentiality carve-outs (including independent development, which preserves our freedom to develop), and boilerplate. Section 19 is a mutual one-year non-solicitation of employees, not a non-compete, and it binds Garman equally. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no redline is required.
